newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise Oil, Amoco to swap N.Sea blocks.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise Oil, Amoco to swap N.Sea blocks.

text.p: Enterprise Oil Plc and Amoco (UK) Exploration Co said on Wednesday they agreed to swap a number of blocks in the Central Graben area of the North Sea.
The companies said the DTI indicated that it had no objection in principle to the exchange.
They expected final consents and completion of the deal before the end of the year.
Amoco, part of U.S.-based Amoco Corp, will gain an additional 25.77 percent interest in Blocks 30/11b and 30/12b, which contain the Appleton and Halley discoveries.

Additionally, Amoco will receive a further 6.03 percent interest in Block 22/18 other than the Montrose and Arbroath Field areas and a 0.23 percent interest in Block 15/22 other than the Scott and Telford unit areas.

As part of the transaction, Amoco will fund a limited share of Enterprise's costs on the 22/18-6 well, which is currently drilling, and a limited share of Enterprise's costs on the next wildcat/appraisal well on Block 15/22.
In September, Amoco said a new appraisal well on the Halley Field had proved additional reserves.
"We are delighted to increase our equity in an asset close to the Fulmar Field infrastructure where we are an existing owner," Amoco said.
